activities.description: The teacher is giving a lecture about radioactive isotopes and their half life.

characterInteraction.description: The teacher interacts with the students by asking questions and gauging their understanding.

scenes.contextualRelevance: By asking the question about Thorium's decay, the teacher encourages students to apply their understanding of half-life to conceptualize vast timescales.

narrativeProgression.description: The teacher starts by mentioning Thorium only has one isotope.
He poses a question about how much Thorium would be left if the universe was twice as old.
The teacher transitions to discussing Uranium and its two isotopes.
